Unmoved. As long as you have more life than you started with, other creatures you control have unmoved. When this dies, draw two cards and gain 3 life.
cards.note: rules text of Boethius in the Tower

cards.key: In his cell he wrote that Philosophy came to console him. Then he went out to his death a Christian, and Pavia keeps his feast.
cards.note: flavour text of Boethius in the Tower

cards.key: Abbot's Astronomical Clock
At the beginning of your upkeep, gain 2 life. Upkeep 1 (at the beginning of your upkeep, pay 1 or sacrifice this).
cards.note: rules text of Abbot's Astronomical Clock

cards.key: The abbot built it to ring the Hours. The brothers still rise to pray them, for a clock can count the Office but never say it.
cards.note: flavour text of Abbot's Astronomical Clock

cards.key: Gallows Oak
Deathtouch (any damage this deals to a creature destroys it). Regenerate (the first time each turn it would be destroyed, it is tapped and healed instead).
The Pact hanged its oathbreakers from the oldest oak in the wood, and the oak learned the wrong lesson.
Demon at the Masked Ball
Haste. Dread (can only be blocked by Pact creatures and Constructs). When this enters, you lose 2 life.
cards.note: rules text of Demon at the Masked Ball

cards.key: Every guest wore a mask, so no one remarked on his until the music stopped.
cards.note: flavour text of Demon at the Masked Ball

cards.key: Apostate of the Porch
When this enters, draw two cards and you lose 2 life. As long as you have four or more cards in hand, this has deathtouch.
cards.note: rules text of Apostate of the Porch

cards.key: He left the Porch for the sealed books. The Pact taught him gladly, and named the fee only afterwards.
cards.note: flavour text of Apostate of the Porch

cards.key: Bone Mill Engine
Dread (can only be blocked by Pact creatures and Constructs). Assembly (this gets +1/+1 for each other Construct you control). Sacrifice another creature: put a +1/+1 counter on this.
cards.note: rules text of Bone Mill Engine

cards.key: The guild bought bones by the cartload and asked no questions. The Pact sold them by the cartload and answered none.
cards.note: flavour text of Bone Mill Engine

cards.key: Sacrifice another creature: put a +1/+1 counter on this.
cards.note: activated ability text of Bone Mill Engine

cards.key: Satyr-King of the Vintage
Trample. When this enters, create two 1/1 Goat Beast tokens with haste. Whenever this attacks, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
cards.note: rules text of Satyr-King of the Vintage

cards.key: By the end of the vintage the grapes were trampled, the wine was drunk, and the vineyard was gone.
cards.note: flavour text of Satyr-King of the Vintage

At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have four or more cards in hand, create a 1/1 Sapling token.

cards.key: Asked why an old man plants oaks, he said that Nature asks him only to plant, not to sit in the shade.

cards.key: Moss-Grown Sentry
Regenerate (the first time each turn it would be destroyed, it is tapped and healed instead). Assembly (this gets +1/+1 for each other Construct you control).
Its guild was dissolved a century ago. The ivy holds its joints together now, and it guards the grove instead of the gate.
Epicurean on the Porch Steps
Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): tax 1 (the enemy's next non-land card costs 1 more).
cards.note: rules text of Epicurean on the Porch Steps

cards.key: "Pleasure is the highest good," he says from his cushion. The Stoics have been refuting him since noon, and the enemy envoy is still waiting for a hearing.
cards.note: flavour text of Epicurean on the Porch Steps

cards.key: Pyrotechnic Automaton
Haste. Overclock 2 (you may pay 2 more as you play this). If overclocked, when this enters, deal 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
The Revel ordered a spectacle. The guild delivered one, itemised, with a surcharge for the burns.
Reckoning Engine of Rhodes

At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card, then foresight 2 (look at the top two cards of your library, put any of them back on top and the rest on the bottom). Upkeep 1 (at the beginning of your upkeep, pay 1 or sacrifice this).
cards.note: rules text of Reckoning Engine of Rhodes

cards.key: The Stoics called the cosmos a perfect mechanism. The guild took them at their word and built one.
cards.note: flavour text of Reckoning Engine of Rhodes

The grove-keepers of Elderholt grow herbs the sick need. Carry a letter asking for them.
Pact cultists prey on pilgrims bound for the Cathedral of the Lamp. Defeat three of them.
A party of pilgrims carries relics to the chapel of the scholars' city. See them safely to Porticus.
Ser Gaudenz, last of the Templars, has shut himself in his chapel and duels all who come. Overcome him and bring him to confession.
A lich has made his crypt in a ruined abbey to the south. Cleanse the holy ground.
The herald of Belzareth stirs in the deepest pit. Go down with the Lamp and drive him back.
Some scholars borrowed against their souls and now hide behind their books. Defeat three of them.
The Church's knights guard the roads too well. Defeat three servants of the Church.
The Nameless Lich grants nothing to the weak. Defeat him in his crypt and he will name his price.
The herald of the pit tests every new servant. Survive the test.
Constructs are cutting the old woods for the furnaces of Cogspire. Stop three of them.
The great beast of the north wood has gone mad. Calm it the old way: by besting it.
A foundry has broken loose and burns everything around it. Put out its fires.
Ash from the Pit is poisoning the fields. Defeat three Pact blighters.
Sour philosophers keep lecturing the guests about moderation. Beat three of them at cards.
The guildsmen of Cogspire have never heard a good song. Take the show there.
Duke Carnevale's feast has lasted a year. Somebody must win the final toast.
The guild says the carnival is a waste of good brass. Prove them wrong against three of their machines.
Observe the excesses of Vinemere, and return unchanged.
The revellers mock the Porch. Answer three of them in the only language they respect.
Our old master has stopped speaking and started duelling. Bring him back to reason.
The Scholarch wishes to correspond with the Church about the soul. Carry his letters to Santa Lucerna.
Carry the guild's accounts north to Santa Lucerna.
The druids keep sabotaging the timber carts. Defeat three of them.
Our best foundry has broken its governors. Shut it down before it melts the district.
The Silent Sage owes the guild for an orrery. Collect, by duel if necessary.
